what: a sunlit stone courtyard: an open arcade of pale stone columns and arches along a pale plaster wall, a black iron railing on a low plinth in front of the arcade, olive trees in terracotta pots, worn stone paving
first_view: from the open paving, looking at the black iron railing on its low plinth and the open arcade of pale stone columns and arches behind it, an olive tree in a terracotta pot.
views: from the open paving further along the railing, looking back along it: the railing, its plinth and the arcade with its columns and arches run along the right side of the frame, the open sunlit paving along the left side
from the shade under the arcade, close behind the railing, looking straight out across the open courtyard at its far side
from the other end of the railing looking along it the other way: the railing and the arcade on the left, the open paving on the right
overhead: a straight-down view of the whole courtyard, like an architect's cutaway: the arcade along the top edge, the railing in front of it, the open paving below
